suggestions.title: Boost Instagram Content Frequency and Hashtag Strategy
suggestions.problem: Instagram reach is critically low at only 2 impressions today, indicating severe visibility issues despite having website traffic
suggestions.root_cause: Likely infrequent posting schedule and/or ineffective hashtag strategy. With only 2 reach, content is not being discovered by the target audience searching for bakery/cafe recommendations
suggestions.suggestion: Increase posting frequency to at least 4-5 times per week with strategic hashtags. Create a content calendar focused on: new bakery discoveries, seasonal sweets, customer features, and behind-the-scenes content. Use 20-25 relevant hashtags including mix of high-volume (#パン屋さん, #カフェ) and niche tags (#ちるまる, #新作パン)
suggestions.expected_impact: Increase Instagram reach from 2 to 50-100+ daily impressions within 2-3 weeks, driving referral traffic to website and improving overall brand awareness
suggestions.implementation_note: Example hashtag sets: #パン屋 #カフェ好きさんと繋がりたい #新作パン紹介 #ベーカリー #カフェ巡り #スイーツ好きさんと繋がりたい #ちるまるで発見 #おいしいパン屋さん

suggestions.title: Improve Session-to-Engagement Conversion Rate
suggestions.problem: Website engagement ratio is poor: only 44% of sessions are engaged (45 engaged out of 102 total sessions). Recent days show deteriorating engagement (0 engaged sessions on 8/21)
suggestions.root_cause: Users are visiting but not interacting meaningfully with content. Likely causes: unclear site navigation, slow page load times, uncompelling bakery listings, or missing call-to-action elements that guide users to explore bakeries
suggestions.suggestion: Audit and optimize key landing pages and bakery detail pages. Add engagement hooks: prominent 'Add to Favorites' buttons, high-quality bakery photos, user reviews, location maps, and operating hours. Implement a sticky header with search/filter functionality. Test reducing initial page load time to under 2 seconds
suggestions.expected_impact: Increase engaged sessions from 44% to 60-70% conversion rate, resulting in 60-70 engaged sessions from current 102 total sessions. Better engagement signals improve SEO ranking and increase repeat visits
suggestions.implementation_note: Add engagement tracking: document clicks on favorite buttons, reviews read, map views, and time-on-page per bakery. Set target: average session duration >2 minutes and at least 2 page views per session

suggestions.title: Stabilize Traffic Volatility with Content Strategy
suggestions.problem: Website traffic shows high volatility: sessions range from 2-9 daily with no clear pattern. Aug 20 peaked at 9 sessions but Aug 21 dropped to 2, and recent days (8/20-8/21) show declining engagement (0 engaged sessions)
suggestions.root_cause: Lack of consistent, scheduled content updates or seasonal promotion strategy. Users visit sporadically without regular reasons to return. No apparent correlation between Instagram activity and website traffic suggests weak cross-channel promotion
suggestions.suggestion: Establish weekly content calendar with guaranteed updates: 'Bakery of the Week' feature posted every Monday, weekend café recommendations posted Fridays, seasonal menu highlights posted monthly. Cross-promote Instagram posts to website via banner or newsletter to create traffic predictability
suggestions.expected_impact: Stabilize daily sessions to consistent 8-12 range by creating recurring user visit patterns. Expected 30% increase in average daily sessions and reduced volatility through regular content scheduling
suggestions.implementation_note: Example weekly schedule: Mon='新作パン紹介', Wed='カフェスポット', Fri='週末のおすすめ'. Use GA4 event tracking: track which content types drive highest engagement, then double down on top performers
